ABELFLEX: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Abelflex, July 2026, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/abelflex.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Abelflex where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. A flexible, lightweight, closed cell, cross-linked, polyethylene foam expansion joint and space filler. Used in concrete and brickwork, Abelflex is compressible and has excellent recovery properties.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Ideal as a gap filler and bond breaker for floor and wall expansion joints, filling systems for roads, motorways, bridges, brick and block walls, concrete and automotive applications
    - In joints where polystyrene or bitumen impregnated fillers have been used, Abelflex is ideal as a bondbreaker. Often necessary due to sealant incompatib-ility with these forms of fillers
    - Suitable as a back-up filler for most elastomeric joint sealants
    - Ideal for stopping contaminants such as soil and debris entering the expansion slots and joints

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Abelflex
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: EXPANSION JOINT AND SPACE FILLER (Zip Rolls)
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 01.04) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 1798: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation at maximum tensile force (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.1).
    - DIN 53507: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Tear propagation resistance (p.2).
    - ISO 1856: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Compression resistance (p.2); Technical Information > Service temperature (p.2).
    - ISO1856: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Compression resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - • Non-absorbent
    - • Excellent recovery after compression
    - • Readily compressible
    - • Seals gaps against dust, debris and water entry • Easy to work with and cut
    - • Resistant to most chemicals
    - • Compatible with most elastomeric joint sealants • Lightweight and easy to handle on-site
    - • Easily moulded to suit other applications
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyethylene Foam
    - Appearance and colour: Dark Grey Foam
    - Density: 25 kg/m³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile strength: Longitudinal 0.21 MPa (ISO 1798); Transversal 0.16 MPa (ISO 1798)
    - Tear propagation resistance: Longitudinal 0.60 N/mm (DIN 53507); Transversal 0.60 N/mm (DIN 53507)
    - Chemical resistance: Water; Salt solutions; Diluted acids; Diluted alkalis; Alcohols; Common cleaning solutions
    - Service temperature: -40° C Min / +95° C Max (ISO 1856)
    - Compression resistance: Compression set (22N, 25%, 23° C) 0.5 hrs < 19% (ISO1856) 24 hrs < 10% (ISO 1856)
    - Elongation at maximum tensile force: Longitudinal 90% (ISO 1798); Transversal 105% (ISO 1798)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 10mm x 50mm x 25m; 10mm x 75mm x 25m; 10mm x 100mm x 25m
    - Shelf life: When stored in dry conditions this product has an unlimited shelf life.
    - Storage conditions: Cool dry area free from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - 1. Attach to concrete with general purpose construction adhesive or a caulking compound during erection of pre-cast concrete panels.
    - 2. Insert into expansion joints, tearing off the zip to leave a pre-formed well for installation of the sealant compound such as butyl, polysulphide, polyurethane, acrylic and silicone sealants.
    - 3. Zipping - slit through 90% of the thickness to a prescribed depth (standard 10mm) following curing. The zip can readily be torn off, leaving a pre-formed well for installation of the sealant or caulking compound.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Abelflex, July 2026, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/abelflex.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
